name: ideal_observer_ct_resolution
description: Minimum detectable disc diameter and spatial-frequency limit for CT imaging under the projection-domain SKE/BKE ideal observer (Rose criterion). Reconstruction-independent upper bound on detectability. Provides both the at-isocentre closed form and a fan-beam off-axis extension that maps d_min(P) across the phantom.
primary_reference: Barrett HH, Myers KJ. Foundations of Image Science. Wiley, 2004.

N0.description: Photons per pixel in the unattenuated beam (noise-equivalent quanta).

mu_bg.description: Linear attenuation coefficient of the background (e.g. water at the scan kVp).

L.description: Background path length through phantom diameter (mm). For a uniform circular phantom, L = 2R.

N_theta.description: Total number of projection angles in the scan.

delta_a_obj.description: Detector pixel pitch projected to the object plane at the isocentre.

delta_mu.description: Linear-attenuation contrast of the feature vs background. For HU contrast: delta_mu = (delta_HU / 1000) * mu_water.

d_prime_threshold.description: Detectability threshold for the Rose criterion. Classical value is 3; Hsieh et al. 2022 argue the minimum viable is 5.

D.description: Source-to-isocentre distance (SOD, mm). Must be greater than R.

arc_start_deg.description: Start of projection arc in degrees (lab frame).

arc_end_deg.description: End of projection arc in degrees (lab frame). For a full scan, arc_end - arc_start >= 360.

N_bg.description: Mean photons per pixel after passing through the background (at isocentre).

d_min.description: Minimum detectable disc diameter at the given contrast, at the isocentre.

chord_fan.description: Chord length through phantom for ray from point source S(theta) through voxel P=(x,y). Source S(theta) = (D*cos theta, D*sin theta).
chord_fan.formula_python:
sx, sy = D*math.cos(theta), D*math.sin(theta)
dx, dy = x - sx, y - sy
len2 = dx*dx + dy*dy
Sdot = sx*dx + sy*dy
disc = (Sdot*Sdot)/len2 - (D*D - R*R)
chord = 2 * math.sqrt(disc) if disc > 0 else 0

delta_a_obj_local.description: Local object-plane pixel pitch at voxel P for projection angle theta.
delta_a_obj_local.formula_python: delta_a_obj * math.hypot(x - D*math.cos(theta), y - D*math.sin(theta)) / D

d_min_at_P.description: Minimum detectable disc diameter at voxel P=(x,y), summing over all N_theta projections in the scan arc.
d_min_at_P.formula_python:
# theta_j = N_theta values evenly spaced in [arc_start_rad, arc_end_rad]
S = sum(
    N0 * math.exp(-mu_bg * chord_fan(theta_j, x, y, R, D))
    / math.hypot(x - D*math.cos(theta_j), y - D*math.sin(theta_j))
    for theta_j in projection_angles
)
d_min_at_P = (3 * d_prime_threshold**2 * delta_a_obj / (2 * delta_mu**2 * D * S)) ** (1/3)
d_min_at_P.reduces_to: At P = (0,0) and D -> infinity, this collapses to the at-isocentre d_min above.

example.context: GE eXplore CT 120 micro-CT at 80 kVp, 500 HU object contrast, at isocentre.

n0_measurement.description: Procedure to measure N0 from raw flat-field projections.
steps: Flat-field correct each projection: T = (I - dark) / (bright - dark)
Select air pixels: those with T in [0.8, 1.2] in both adjacent frames
Compute differenced variance: Var(T) = Var[(T1 - T2) / sqrt(2)]
Invert for noise-equivalent photon count: N0 = 1 / Var(T)
n0_measurement.notes: The sqrt(2) factor removes correlated fixed-pattern noise between the two frames. The resulting N0 is the noise-equivalent quanta per pixel and is the correct input to the formulas, independent of detector gain.

assumptions: Off-axis extension uses 2D fan-beam point source at distance D; cone-beam (off-central-slice) effects are not modelled
limitations: SKE and BKE make this an upper bound. Real reconstructions in structured anatomy will be worse, typically 3–7x in d_min.
